![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14223647/assets/3121d24ea2b9eac3d95c34202619800331d4719c786b8f5a1051350370a1bea2.png)

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r,$ where $C$ is the closed polygonal path $TUVT,$ shown in the diagram above, traversed in the **clockwise** direction?
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that we can represent $C,$ which is traversed in clockwise, as the union of $3$ paths:

$$
C=\{-{C}_{1}\}\cup {C}_{2}\cup {C}_{3},
$$

where $-{C}_{1}$ is the same path as ${C}_{1}$ but traversed in the opposite direction.

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r & ={\int }_{-{C}_{1}}F\cdot \text{d}r+{\int }_{{C}_{2}}F\cdot \text{d}r+{\int }_{{C}_{3}}F\cdot \text{d}r \\  & =-{\int }_{{C}_{1}}F\cdot \text{d}r+{\int }_{{C}_{2}}F\cdot \text{d}r+{\int }_{{C}_{3}}F\cdot \text{d}r.\end{aligned}
$$
